title: Dragon Ball: From Penguin Village to the End of Z
summary: An expanding series of substantive, source-grounded audio essays beginning with Akira Toriyama’s early career and Dr. Slump, then following the original Dragon Ball adventure and its later Z television era. Three complete opening lectures introduce the creator, the robot girl Arale, and Goku and Bulma’s first quest. Future essays will address characters, manga art, animation and the franchise’s global reception. Not a scene-by-scene recap.
assumed_background: No prior knowledge required to begin. The first two essays introduce Toriyama and Dr. Slump, and 003000 begins at Dragon Ball chapter one.
Spoiler notices precede the narration; the first three lectures contain major plot outcomes only for the initial Dragon Ball quest.
Fan-focused audio essays; the published catalog lists only fully written manuscripts. The final Z-era material is an editorial plan, not yet recorded or published.
